By Jacob Rivera, at Ultimate Snooze

Every summer, a certain major online retailer runs a two-day shopping event that has become one of the most anticipated sales of the year. People set alarms, load up carts, and stock up on everything from kitchen gadgets to electronics at a discount.

We think your mattress deserves that same moment.

That's why we created Ultimate Sleep Week, running June 20-26, and it is our biggest sale of the year. For seven days, you get 20% off sitewide plus a FREE set of Breezeline Organic Cooling Sheets with every mattress purchase. No codes, no fine print, no one-day-only panic.

Just the best price we offer on the cleanest sleep system we know how to build.

What Is Ultimate Sleep Week?

Ultimate Sleep Week is The Ultimate Snooze's answer to the summer shopping season. While most big sales focus on electronics and household goods, we built ours around something that affects your health, your recovery, and your quality of life every single day: your sleep.

We believe a mattress purchase deserves more than an impulse click. It's one of the most important investments you make in your body. So we run Ultimate Sleep Week as a full seven-day window, giving you time to research, compare, and make a confident decision rather than racing a countdown timer.

This year, the sale runs June 20 through June 26 with 20% off every product sitewide and a complimentary set of our 100% Organic Cotton Breezeline Cooling Sheets included with every mattress order.

The Exact Numbers: Here's What You Actually Save

We're not going to make you do the math. Here is exactly what each mattress costs during Ultimate Sleep Week, what you save on the mattress itself, and the value of the free sheet set included.

Built for sleepers who want a plush, pressure-relieving feel. Organic latex, organic wool comfort layer, organic cotton cover, individually wrapped coils. No foam, no fiberglass, no synthetics.

Every order also gets FREE Shipping, a 100-night trial, and a 30-year warranty, so the value extends far beyond the sale window.

Why a Mattress Is Worth More Attention Than a Flash Sale Item

Most things people buy during summer shopping events get used for a few months and sit in a drawer. Your mattress is something you spend 7 to 9 hours on every single night for the next decade or more. What it's made of matters in a way that most products simply don't.

Conventional mattresses are manufactured with petroleum-based synthetic foams that trap body heat throughout the night, making it harder for your core temperature to drop, which is a physical requirement for deep sleep. They off-gas volatile organic compounds into the air of your bedroom, the room where you spend a third of your life. Many contain fiberglass hidden inside the cover, microplastics embedded in the materials, and synthetic chemical flame retardants that most consumers never know are there.

The EPA has documented that indoor VOC concentrations are consistently higher than outdoor levels, and the bedroom is one of the primary sources. When you upgrade to an organic mattress, you're not just buying a more comfortable surface. You're removing a nightly exposure that most people never think to question.

What Makes the Ultimate Snooze Different

Every mattress in the Ultimate Snooze lineup is built around four materials chosen specifically for what they do for your sleep and what they don't put into your body.

Natural Latex is breathable, responsive, and durable. Its open-cell structure allows air to flow freely, preventing the heat buildup that keeps so many people awake. It contours to the body without the slow, heavy sinkage of memory foam, and it holds its support for years longer than synthetic alternatives. According to the Sleep Foundation, natural latex is among the most durable and temperature-neutral materials available in mattress construction.

Organic Wool is one of nature's most effective temperature regulators. It wicks moisture away from the body, breathes in both directions, and adapts naturally to your body's microclimate throughout the night, keeping you cooler when you're warm and warmer when the room is cool. It also serves as a natural, chemical-free fire barrier, eliminating the need for the synthetic flame retardants found in most mattresses.

Organic Cotton wraps the entire sleep surface in a soft, breathable cover that feels clean and familiar from the first night. No synthetic coatings, no chemical treatments. Just a surface that lets air move and keeps moisture from building up between you and the mattress.

Non-Toxic Construction means no polyurethane foam, no fiberglass, no synthetic flame retardants, and no microplastics. The mattress you sleep on shouldn't be something you have to worry about. At The Ultimate Snooze, it isn't.

Plus: Free Organic Cotton Sheets

Every mattress purchased during Ultimate Sleep Week includes a complimentary set of our Breezeline Organic Cooling Sheet Set, made from 100% certified organic cotton. Because a non-toxic mattress deserves a non-toxic surface to go with it. Your sheets are the layer closest to your body every single night. It's worth making sure they're clean too.

Don't Forget: 20% Off Everything Else Too

The 20% discount applies sitewide, so if you want to complete your sleep system during Ultimate Sleep Week, now is the time. Browse our adjustable bases, organic pillows, and accessories at 20% off alongside your mattress order.

When Is Ultimate Sleep Week?

June 20-26, 2025. Seven days. 20% off sitewide. Free organic cotton sheets with every mattress. One of the most important purchases you'll make for your health, at the best price we offer all year.

Shop Ultimate Sleep Week now and start your 100-night trial.
